description: Each media type's byte rate is the mean of its tracks' individual Bytes/Milliseconds ratios.

d.request: For each media type, calculate the average unit price of its tracks and the mean of each individual track's bytes-per-millisecond ratio; filter to media types whose mean bytes-per-millisecond exceeds the overall average of all media types' mean bytes-per-millisecond; return one row with the average of filtered media types' average unit prices, the average of filtered media types' mean bytes-per-millisecond, and the average of filtered media types' individual deviations from the cross-media-type average bytes-per-millisecond.
d.sql: WITH media_type_metrics AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0 THEN CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds ELSE NULL END) as mean_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(mean_bytes_per_ms) as overall_mean_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_metrics), filtered_media_types AS (SELECT mtm.avg_unit_price, mtm.mean_bytes_per_ms FROM media_type_metrics mtm CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE mtm.mean_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL AND mtm.mean_bytes_per_ms > os.overall_mean_bytes_per_ms) SELECT AVG(fmt.avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices, AVG(fmt.mean_bytes_per_ms) as avg_of_mean_bytes_per_ms, AVG(fmt.mean_bytes_per_ms) - os.overall_mean_bytes_per_ms as avg_deviation FROM filtered_media_types fmt CROSS JOIN overall_stats os

a.request: For each media type (`Track.MediaTypeId`), across all tracks, work out the average track `UnitPrice` and the average of each track's `Bytes` divided by its `Milliseconds` (tracks with no size ignored). Take the simple average of that byte rate across the media types, and keep only the media types whose rate is above it. Return one row with: the average of their average unit prices, the average of their byte rates, and the average amount by which their rate exceeds the cross-media-type average (rate minus that average). Don't round anything.
a.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) as avg_byte_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_byte_rate) as overall_avg_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
  WHERE avg_byte_rate IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_types AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.avg_unit_price,
    mt.avg_byte_rate,
    mt.avg_byte_rate - oa.overall_avg_byte_rate as excess
  FROM media_type_stats mt
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE mt.avg_byte_rate > oa.overall_avg_byte_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_unit_price),
  AVG(avg_byte_rate),
  AVG(excess)
FROM filtered_types

b.request: For each media type, compute the average track unit price and the mean of individual track bytes-to-milliseconds ratios; identify media types whose mean ratio exceeds the overall mean ratio across all media types; output the average of their average unit prices, the average of their mean ratios, and the average difference between each media type's mean ratio and the overall mean ratio.
b.sql:
WITH track_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds AS ratio,
    UnitPrice
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM track_ratios
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_mean_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM track_ratios
),
filtered_media_types AS (
  SELECT
    mts.MediaTypeId,
    mts.avg_unit_price,
    mts.mean_ratio,
    (mts.mean_ratio - omr.overall_mean) AS ratio_difference
  FROM media_type_stats mts
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean_ratio omr
  WHERE mts.mean_ratio > omr.overall_mean
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(mean_ratio) AS avg_of_mean_ratios,
  AVG(ratio_difference) AS avg_of_ratio_differences
FROM filtered_media_types
b.raw: For each media type, compute the average track unit price and the mean of individual track bytes-to-milliseconds ratios; identify media types whose mean ratio exceeds the overall mean ratio across all media types; output the average of their average unit prices, the average of their mean ratios, and the average difference between each media type's mean ratio and the overall mean ratio.

c.request: For each media type, looking at all tracks, work out the average track unit price and its bytes per millisecond. Keep the media types whose bytes per millisecond is above the simple average across media types. Give one row with: the average of their average unit prices, the average of their bytes per millisecond, and on average how far their rate is above that cross-media-type average (rate minus average). No rounding. Each media type's byte rate is the mean of its tracks' individual Bytes/Milliseconds ratios.
c.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.MediaTypeId,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track t
  GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS simple_average
  FROM media_type_stats
),
filtered_media_types AS (
  SELECT 
    mts.MediaTypeId,
    mts.avg_unit_price,
    mts.byte_rate,
    oa.simple_average
  FROM media_type_stats mts
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE mts.byte_rate > oa.simple_average
)
SELECT
  AVG(fmt.avg_unit_price),
  AVG(fmt.byte_rate),
  AVG(fmt.byte_rate - fmt.simple_average)
FROM filtered_media_types fmt
